description: Record a scale/cut/hold decision for the reporting period the caller reviewed. AttriKit freezes that period's current campaign range, spend, costs, revenue basis, and model version server-side; callers cannot author receipt provenance.

call.description: The decision being frozen. Report get_campaign_decision's own call verbatim rather than forming your own.

campaign_id.description: The AttriKit campaign uuid, as returned by list_campaigns or get_campaign_decision. Not the ad network's own campaign id.

idempotency_key.description: Stable retry key for this exact mutation.

period.description: The reporting window you reviewed; the receipt freezes that window. Pass the same period you read. Omitted, this tool and get_campaign_decision use all, while list_campaigns defaults to 30d.

name: record_campaign_decision
title: Record a campaign decision
